objectives.description: Reuse lower-level object/food/price grammar and current A2 measurement/comparison/aspect systems.
objectives.rationale: Prerequisites: all retained A1-H foods/objects/clothes/place/payment senses; A1-F-297 narrow ADV price versus -037 DET quantity; A2-F-034 broad measurement, -035–050 comparison, -079–089 duration, -094–120 aspect/conditions, -126–145 size/material. Dependencies may be unresolved proposals, not new H words. A1-H-163 calefacción and -164 aire acondicionado are already proposed A1 (the A2-H calefacción seed is reuse, not a new introduction); A1-W-086/-087 plug/socket and -090 cable support reporting rather than operating electricity. objectives.description: Produce a bounded recipe step, polite complaint or repair request with appropriate person forms.
objectives.rationale: Unresolved F/D grammar prerequisite: imperative versus infinitive recipe style, object/clitic agreement, sequence markers and tú/usted requests. Do not mint every instruction sentence or promise that a polite formula guarantees agreement. A1-D/F bounded request/repair and quantity/price prerequisites are not a claim that all recipe imperatives or impersonal constructions are already licensed; A2-F/D must resolve exact productivity and person/clitic forms before learner authoring. Numerals, fractions and calendar/appointment values remain finite F paradigms, not infinitely generated H senses.

objectives.description: Reserve detailed culinary techniques, construction diagnosis and contract/dispute procedures.
objectives.rationale: A2 includes routine descriptions and selected action labels, not comprehensive cooking methods, structural/electrical repairs, consumer-law claims or lease negotiation. B1-H/B2-H must adjudicate these scopes independently.
